szoveg_eredeti:
Every team I talk to starts with Hermes ( Nous Research ), Deep Agents or one of the other popular harnesses. Makes sense, there are great harnesses out there. But then enterprise requirements come in: policy controls, approvals, guardrails, sovereign deployment. Suddenly you're building another harness instead of focusing on your agent.

That's the gap we built CUGA agent to close. Policies and enterprise guarantees like sovereignty come built into it, so you don't have to build them yourself. We benchmarked it against Hermes ( Nous Research ) and Deep Agents on an AppWorld subset and the results are pretty impressive! More in our blog post below.

The best way to feel what I mean is to play with CUGA's policy controls in the Hugging Face Space we put up-- let us know your feedback!
